# HB Robotics Knowledge Base

> Canonical public knowledge base for practical robotics and ROS 2 problem solving.

Primary site: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/wimblerobotics/wimblerobotics.github.io

## What This Site Is

This site is a curated, source-backed robotics knowledge base focused on practical ROS 2 work.
It is designed to help readers solve concrete robot problems, then branch into nearby topics worth learning next.

## High-Value Entry Points

- Home: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/
- Solve a Problem: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/
- Nav2 Architecture: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/nav2-architecture/
- Robot Networking: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/robot-networking/
- Robot Health: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/robot-health/
- Robot Calibration Workflows: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/calibration-workflows/
- Performance Debugging and Tracing: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/performance-debugging/
- Docking and Semantic Navigation: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/docking-semantic-navigation/
- Map Lifecycle and Field Updates: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/notes/map-lifecycle/

- Foundations: https://wimblerobotics.github.io/foundations/ros2-core-communication-and-execution/

## Editorial Model

- Articles point to stronger original sources.
- Articles summarize the practical technical value of those sources.
- Articles cross-link through tags and explicit related links.
- Notes under `/notes/` act as short routing pages from problem to likely answer.

## Provenance And Quality

- This repository is the canonical source for the published site.
- Every article includes source provenance in frontmatter.
- Generated structure summaries live in `generated/topic_graph.json` and `generated/topic_graph.md` in the repository.
